newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM V GRASSHOPPER ZURICH TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM V GRASSHOPPER ZURICH TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup match between Ajax Amsterdam of the Netherlands and Grasshopper Zurich of Switzerland in group A of the Champions' League:

Ajax Amsterdam: 1-Edwin Van der Sar; 20-Marcio Santos, 3-Danny Blind, 4-Frank de Boer, 5-Winston Bogarde; 17-Mariano Juan, 10-Jari Litmanen, 18-Kiki Musampa; 7-Tijani Babangida, 6-Ronald de Boer, 11-Marc Overmars

Grasshopper Zurich: 1-Pascal Zuberbuehler, 2-Harald Gaemperle, 28-Bernt Haas, 4-Mats Gren, 3-Pascal Thueler; 10-Massimo Lombardo, 6-Murat Yakin, 7-Antonio Esposito, 14-Johann Vogel; 9-Viorel Moldovan, 19-Joel Magnin
